questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: The filename and filename extension are separated by a ________.
questions.answer: The filename and extension are separated by a dot (.). For example, in 'document.odt', the dot separates the filename 'document' from the extension 'odt'.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Which of the following type of communication involves interchanging messages only through images or pictures?
questions.answer: Visual communication involves interchanging messages only through images or pictures. It uses signs, symbols, pictures, and other visual elements to convey information.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: ________ is the ability to identify and manage one's own emotions, as well as the emotions of others.
questions.answer: Emotional Intelligence is the ability to identify and manage one's own emotions, as well as the emotions of others. It involves self-awareness, self-regulation, motivation, empathy, and social skills.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: ________ is the driving force that pushes us to achieve our goals, feel happy and improve our quality of life.
questions.answer: Self-Motivation is the driving force that pushes us to achieve our goals, feel happy and improve our quality of life. It is the internal drive that compels us to take action and persist toward our objectives.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Which of the following is not an essential quality to become a successful entrepreneur?
questions.answer: Wealthy is not an essential quality to become a successful entrepreneur. Essential qualities include confidence, creativity, patience, leadership, risk-taking ability, and decision-making skills. Wealth is a result of successful entrepreneurship, not a prerequisite.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: In total, how many SDGs were adopted by the United Nations in 2015 as a universal call to action to end poverty, protect the planet, and ensure that by 2030 all people enjoy peace and prosperity?
questions.answer: 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) were adopted by the United Nations in 2015 as a universal call to action to end poverty, protect the planet, and ensure that by 2030 all people enjoy peace and prosperity.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Which of the following features allows one to apply a group of formats at the same time?
questions.answer: Styles allow one to apply a group of formats at the same time. A style is a set of formatting attributes (font, size, color, spacing, etc.) that can be applied together to text or paragraphs.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: In Writer, styles and formatting option is available under ________ menu.
questions.answer: In Writer, styles and formatting option is available under the Format menu. You can access it by going to Format > Styles and Formatting or by pressing F11.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Gaurav is creating a report in Writer. The image gets embedded in his document whenever he drags and drops the image and the document size increases. Suggest a way to link the image file instead of embedding it.
options: Hold down the Ctrl key while dragging.
Hold down the Shift key while dragging the image.
Hold down the Ctrl and Shift key while dragging and dropping the image.
questions.answer: To link an image file instead of embedding it in Writer, hold down the Ctrl and Shift key while dragging and dropping the image. This creates a link to the image file rather than embedding it, keeping the document size smaller.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Resizing a ________ may badly affect the resolution of an image.
questions.answer: Resizing a raster image may badly affect its resolution. Raster images (also called bitmap images) are made up of pixels, so enlarging them causes pixelation and loss of quality. Vector images use mathematical formulas and can be resized without quality loss.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: In Writer, you can create your own template in ________ way(s).
questions.answer: In Writer, you can create your own template in two ways: (1) by creating a document and saving it as a template (File > Save As > Template), or (2) by using the Template Management dialog.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: In Writer, ________ function key is used to see the databases while implementing mail merge.
questions.answer: In Writer, the F4 function key is used to see the databases while implementing mail merge. It opens the data source view showing the database tables and fields.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: While consolidating data, a cell range can be named using ________ option.
questions.answer: While consolidating data, a cell range can be named using the Define Range option (Data > Define Range). This allows you to assign a name to a range of cells for easier reference in consolidation operations.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Kawal and his friends are working on a Spreadsheet for entering data and updating records. They wish to keep a track of changes. Which of the following options will help in knowing who made the changes and what changes were done in the spreadsheet?
questions.answer: Record Changes option (Edit > Track Changes > Record) in Calc helps in knowing who made the changes and what changes were done in the spreadsheet. It tracks all modifications made by different users.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: ________ is a more elaborate form of Goal Seek.
questions.answer: Solver is a more elaborate form of Goal Seek. While Goal Seek works with a single variable, Solver can handle multiple variables and constraints to find an optimal solution.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Macro functions can be written to behave as regular functions by writing a/an ________.
questions.answer: Macro functions can be written to behave as regular functions by writing an Add-In. An Add-In extends the functionality of Calc by adding custom functions that can be used like built-in functions.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: ________ option of Calc helps in viewing the changes made to a worksheet using original and edited worksheet.
questions.answer: Edit -> Compare Document option in Calc helps in viewing the changes made to a worksheet by comparing the original and edited versions side by side.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: In Calc, shared workbooks allow:
questions.answer: In Calc, shared workbooks allow adding text. When a workbook is shared, some features like merging cells, conditional formatting, and inserting pictures/graphs are restricted, but adding text is permitted.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: In OpenOffice Base, the relationship applied on the tables can be removed with the help of ________ option.
questions.answer: In OpenOffice Base, the relationship applied on the tables can be removed with the help of the Delete option. You can right-click on the relation line in the relationship window and select Delete.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: In SQL, the keyword to display records in ascending order is:
questions.answer: In SQL, the keyword to display records in ascending order is ASC. It is used with the ORDER BY clause, e.g., SELECT * FROM table ORDER BY column ASC.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: ________ is a numeric data type which can store Yes/No type values in the form of 0 or 1 in OpenOffice Base table.
questions.answer: Boolean is a numeric data type in OpenOffice Base that stores Yes/No type values in the form of 0 (for No/False) or 1 (for Yes/True).

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Which of the following statement retrieves zero or more rows from one or more database tables or database views?
questions.answer: The SELECT statement retrieves zero or more rows from one or more database tables or database views. It is the primary data retrieval command in SQL.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Roshni has created a table Customer in SQL and wants to store photograph image of every customer under Cust_photo field. Suggest a suitable data type from the options given below.
questions.answer: LONGVARBINARY is the suitable data type for storing photograph images in OpenOffice Base. It can store large binary data such as images, up to 2GB in size.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: By default, all the fields in OpenOffice Base will have ________ datatype.
questions.answer: By default, all the fields in OpenOffice Base will have text (varchar) datatype. VARCHAR stores variable-length character strings.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: A ________ is a discussion style website similar to an online personal diary, used for creating personal web pages.
questions.answer: A Blog (short for weblog) is a discussion style website similar to an online personal diary, used for creating and sharing personal web pages, articles, and opinions.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Natasha works as floor manager. She has been assigned a task for conducting regular ________ to ensure safety of life in case of any disaster or emergency by evacuating the place of danger.
questions.answer: Evacuation drills are conducted regularly to ensure safety of life in case of any disaster or emergency by evacuating the place of danger. They help people practice safe evacuation procedures.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: ________ is an accessibility feature that assists people who have difficulty using a keyboard or a mouse (or both).
questions.answer: Serial Key is an accessibility feature that assists people who have difficulty using a keyboard or a mouse (or both). It allows alternative input devices to be connected through a serial port.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Network in which all computers have equal status is called ________.
questions.answer: Peer-to-Peer architecture is a network in which all computers have equal status. Each computer can act as both a client and a server, sharing resources directly without a central server.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: ________ are text files with small pieces of data like a username and password.
questions.answer: Cookies are text files with small pieces of data like a username and password. They are stored on the user's computer by websites to remember user preferences and login information.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: DSL stands for ________.
questions.answer: DSL stands for Digital Subscriber Line. It is a technology for high-speed internet access that uses existing telephone lines to transmit digital data.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: How can cultural differences be a barrier to effective communication?
questions.answer: Cultural differences can be a barrier to effective communication when people of different cultures are unable to understand each other's customs and traditions. People sometimes make stereotypical assumptions about others based on their cultural background, leading to differences in opinions. This can result in misunderstandings, inconveniences, and difficulties in communication. Different cultures may also interpret gestures, body language, and expressions differently, causing confusion.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Explain any two misconceptions about entrepreneurship.
questions.answer: Two misconceptions about entrepreneurship are: (a) Every business idea needs to be unique or special - This is a misconception because many successful businesses are common businesses that we see every day. Each entrepreneur saw customer demand and brought a new approach into their business. (b) A person needs a lot of money to start a business - This is false because capital is important but every business does not need a lot of capital to start. Depending on how much money you have or can borrow, you can start a business and grow it over time.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Briefly discuss the significance of time management skills in order to succeed in life.
questions.answer: Time management is the ability to plan and control how you spend the hours of your day well and do all that you want to do. It helps you to complete tasks on time, make a daily timetable, estimate how long tasks will take, submit homework and assignments on time, and avoid wasting time during the day. Good time management leads to increased productivity, reduced stress, and better work-life balance.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Very often we hear about spam mails. Explain what are spam mails, and what should be done with such mails.
questions.answer: Spam mails are unsolicited emails, usually from companies advertising products or trying to attract recipients to their websites. They are also called junk mail. Actions to take with spam mails: (1) Never respond to spam emails. (2) Delete them regularly. (3) Set filters in the email settings to prevent spam from entering the inbox. (4) Do not open any attachments in spam emails. (5) Do not click on any links in spam messages.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Mention any two ways to get clean and affordable energy.
questions.answer: Two ways to get clean and affordable energy are: (1) Using solar power - power generated using the sun does not cause pollution as it does not require the burning of non-renewable fuels such as coal. (2) Using biogas - it is an eco-friendly alternative to natural gas produced from organic waste, and is renewable and cleaner burning.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Write the main steps to group drawing objects in Writer.
questions.answer: Steps to group drawing objects in Writer: (1) Select one object, then hold down the Shift key and select the other objects you want to include in the group. The bounding box expands to include all the selected objects. (2) With the objects selected, hover the mouse pointer over one of the objects and choose Format > Group > Group from the menu bar, or right-click and choose Group > Group from the pop-up menu.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the purpose of consolidating data in spreadsheets? Discuss briefly.
questions.answer: The main purpose of Data Consolidation is to gather data together from separate worksheets into a master worksheet. The Data Consolidation function takes data from a series of worksheets or workbooks and summarizes it into a single worksheet that can be updated easily. This helps in combining financial data, sales figures, or any other data from multiple sources for analysis.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Differentiate between LAN and WAN.
questions.answer: LAN (Local Area Network): Connects computers and devices in a limited geographical area such as home, school, computer laboratory, office building, or closely positioned group of buildings. Usually offers very high speeds and is used for connecting computers and peripherals such as printers and scanners. WAN (Wide Area Network): Covers a broad area, linking networks across metropolitan, regional, or national boundaries. The Internet is the most popular WAN, used by businesses, governments, non-profit organizations, and individuals worldwide.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What are the two parts of a cell reference while referencing data on other sheets? Explain with an example.
questions.answer: While referencing data on other sheets, the cell reference has two parts: the sheet name and the cell reference. They are separated by a period. For example: ='Savings Account'.F3 where 'Savings Account' is the name of the sheet and F3 is the cell address whose value we want to access. The sheet name is enclosed in single quotes if it contains spaces.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Give any two benefits of creating relationships between tables in a database.
questions.answer: Benefits of creating relationships between tables in a database: (1) Save time as there is no need to enter the same data in separate tables. (2) Reduce data-entry errors by maintaining data consistency. (3) Summarize data from related tables easily. (4) Maintain accuracy and consistency of data across the database.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Mention any two basic fire safety rules to be followed in any organization.
questions.answer: Basic fire safety rules in an organization: (1) Fire escape plans must be installed at proper levels. (2) Conduct regular fire drills. (3) Smoke alarms must be placed at proper intervals. (4) Keep the workplace a no-smoking zone. (5) Maintenance of safety equipment must be taken care of regularly.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the concept of mail merge in word processing software? Discuss in detail. Also give any two major benefits of using mail merge.
questions.answer: Mail merge is a way to take a letter you have written and send it to a whole bunch of people, personalizing it with information about them so they might think that you typed that letter personally for them. A mail merge can also be a quick way to take a list of people's mailing addresses and generate labels or envelopes with the address for a different person on each label or envelope. The process involves a main document (the letter) and a data source (the list of recipients). Merge fields are placed in the main document where personalized information should appear. Benefits: (1) The Mail Merge feature makes it easy to send the same letter to a large number of people. (2) We do not have to type each recipient's name separately. (3) We need to proofread only the main document. (4) It is economical and saves a lot of time. (5) It is one of the fastest ways to produce hundreds of personalised letters.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Explain four types of hyperlinks that can be applied in spreadsheets.
questions.answer: Four types of hyperlinks in spreadsheets: (1) Internet: the hyperlink points to a web address, normally starting with http://. (2) Mail & News: the hyperlink opens an email message that is pre-addressed to a particular recipient. (3) Document: the hyperlink points to a place in either the current worksheet or another existing worksheet. (4) New document: the hyperlink creates a new worksheet. These hyperlinks can be inserted using the Insert > Hyperlink menu option in Calc.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Internet security is of prime concern nowadays. Using strong passwords can lower the risk of security breach on the Internet. Himanshi has just created her first Internet based account. Help her by giving any four general guidelines for managing strong passwords.
questions.answer: General guidelines for strong passwords: (1) Password must be a combination of uppercase alphabet, lowercase alphabet, digits, and special symbols. (2) It must be 6 to 8 characters long. (3) It must not be the name of family members, friends, pets, etc. (4) It must not be any dictionary words. (5) It must not be your date of birth or any personal information that can be guessed easily. (6) Change your password frequently, at least every 2-3 weeks. (7) Use different passwords for different accounts.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: In the context of OpenOffice Base, explain the concept and significance of the following: (a) Forms (b) Reports
questions.answer: (a) Forms: A form provides the user a systematic way of storing information into the database. It is an interface in a user-specified layout that lets users view, enter, and change data directly in database objects such as tables. Forms make data entry easier and more user-friendly than entering data directly into tables. (b) Reports: A report helps to display the data in a summarized manner. It is used to generate the overall work outcome in a clear and printable format. Reports help to get summarized data from the database for analysis and presentation purposes.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Consider the table Product and write SQL queries: Table: Product(PID, PNAME, PRICE, QUANTITY, CATEGORY). Data: P01,BOARD,10000,2,OFFICE; P02,EYELINER,700,50,MAKEUP; P04,PENCIL,5,500,SCHOOL; P05,LAMP,250,10,DOMESTIC; P08,BEDSHEET,450,45,DOMESTIC; P09,LAPTOP,75000,15,OFFICE. (a) To display names of all products whose category is 'domestic'. (b) To display product name and price whose quantity is less than 50. (c) To display price and quantity of Laptop. (d) To display name and quantity of those products whose price is above 5000.
questions.answer: (a) SELECT PNAME FROM PRODUCT WHERE CATEGORY = 'DOMESTIC'; (b) SELECT PNAME, PRICE FROM PRODUCT WHERE QUANTITY < 50; (c) SELECT PRICE, QUANTITY FROM PRODUCT WHERE PNAME = 'LAPTOP'; (d) SELECT PNAME, QUANTITY FROM PRODUCT WHERE PRICE > 5000;

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: In the context of Database Management System, write a short note on the following: (a) Database (b) Table (c) Field (d) Composite Primary Key
questions.answer: (a) Database: A database is an organized collection of data that can be easily accessed, managed and updated. It stores data in tables that are related to each other. (b) Table: A table is a collection of related data organized in rows (records) and columns (fields). Each table represents a specific entity. (c) Field: A field is a single piece of information in a table. It represents a column that contains a specific type of data for all records. (d) Composite Primary Key: A composite primary key is a combination of two or more columns that uniquely identifies each row in a table. Together they form a unique identifier.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Self awareness refers to
options: our knowledge and understanding of ourselves
systematic efforts to direct thoughts and actions
ability to identify effective methods to move from thought to action
questions.answer: Self-awareness refers to our knowledge and understanding of ourselves. It involves recognizing our own emotions, strengths, weaknesses, values, and motivations.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: If we worry about matters we can do nothing about or we are worrying for no reason at all, we are having ________.
questions.answer: Internal stress is when we worry about matters we can do nothing about or worry for no reason at all. It comes from our own thoughts and attitudes rather than external circumstances.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: The simultaneous processing of two or more programs by multiple processors is
questions.answer: Multi-processing is the simultaneous processing of two or more programs by multiple processors. It uses multiple CPUs to execute multiple processes at the same time.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is a file?
options: A file is a section of main storage used to store data
A file is a collection of information that has been given a name and have an extension
A file is the part of a program that is used to describe what the program should do
A file can be saved only in CDs
questions.answer: A file is a collection of information that has been given a name and has an extension. Files are the basic units of storage on a computer, and the extension indicates the type of file.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: State whether the following statement is true or false: Talent is more important than industry.
questions.answer: False. Industry (hard work) is more important than talent. Hard work, dedication, and perseverance are essential for success in any field.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: To find the suitable market and entrepreneur performs the functions of
questions.answer: To find a suitable market, an entrepreneur performs the functions of advertisement and publicity, as well as appointment of selling agents. These activities help in reaching potential customers and distributing products effectively.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Which extension is given to a document by default in OpenOffice writer?
questions.answer: The default extension for OpenOffice Writer documents is .odt (Open Document Text).

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: The status of your document like current page number and number of pages are given by ________
questions.answer: The status bar, located at the bottom of the Writer window, displays information about the document such as current page number, total number of pages, zoom level, and other status information.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: The documents can be saved by using
questions.answer: Documents can be saved by using any of these methods: Ctrl + S keyboard shortcut, File > Save menu option, or File > Save As to save with a different name or format.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Which of the following alignments are available in writer?
questions.answer: All of these alignments (Left, Right, and Center) are available in Writer. Additionally, Justified alignment is also available.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Line or paragraph spacing is measured in terms of lines or points which is referred as ________.
questions.answer: Leading refers to the line or paragraph spacing measured in terms of lines or points. It is the vertical space between lines of text.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Which term refers to a set of formats consisting of fonts, font color, font size and paragraph formats?
questions.answer: Styles refers to a set of formats consisting of fonts, font color, font size and paragraph formats. A style bundles multiple formatting attributes together for consistent and efficient application.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: According to OpenOffice Calc which of the following is not a What-if analysis tool?
questions.answer: Conditional formatting is not a What-if analysis tool. What-if analysis tools in Calc include Goal Seek, Scenarios, and Solver. Conditional formatting is used to format cells based on conditions.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: The ________ feature creates summarized outline of data in a worksheet.
questions.answer: The Subtotal feature creates a summarized outline of data in a worksheet. It automatically groups data and adds subtotals for each group.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: To start the Macro recorder, which of the following command is used?
questions.answer: To start the Macro recorder in Calc, use Tools > Macros > Record Macro. This records a sequence of actions that can be replayed later.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Linked data is stored in the ________
questions.answer: Linked data is stored in the source file. When you link data, the destination file stores only the reference (link) to the source file, while the actual data remains in the source file.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: This is a type of hyperlink available in Hyperlink dialog box, which creates a new worksheet:
questions.answer: New Document is the type of hyperlink in the Hyperlink dialog box that creates a new worksheet. This option allows creating a link to a new document that will be created.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Rajat has received a spreadsheet, which is reviewed by his subordinates Puneet, Kavya and Aman, who made some corrections in it. Before Rajat shared the spreadsheet with his subordinates, he has activated the track changes feature. Which of the following option he should use now to keep some of the changes made by them?
questions.answer: Rajat should use the Accept and reject changes option to selectively keep some changes made by his subordinates. This feature allows reviewing each change and deciding whether to accept or reject it.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Facilities offered by databases are
options: the ability to store a large amount of data in a structured format, easy update, sort query, production of reports
easy edition, spell check, perform calculations, library of mathematical functions, replications
the ability to rotate images, copy and paste, fill scale
questions.answer: Databases offer the ability to store a large amount of data in a structured format, easy update, sort, query, and production of reports. These are core database features.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Which one of the following is an example of RDBMS?
questions.answer: Oracle is an example of RDBMS (Relational Database Management System). Other examples include MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Microsoft SQL Server.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Database servers are referred to as ________
questions.answer: Database servers are referred to as back-ends. They run the database management system and handle data storage, retrieval, and management on the server side.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Out of the following, which one is the most appropriate data field in context of employee table, if only one of these is required?
questions.answer: Date of birth is the most appropriate data field because it is permanent and does not change. Age can be calculated from the date of birth whenever needed, whereas age in years/days/months becomes outdated.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: The ________ has evolved since the 1960s to ease increasing difficulties in designing, building and maintaining complex information system.
questions.answer: The Database concept has evolved since the 1960s to ease increasing difficulties in designing, building and maintaining complex information systems. Databases provide structured data storage and management.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Computer Based Record Keeping system is known as
questions.answer: Computer Based Record Keeping system is known as DBMS (Database Management System). A DBMS is software that manages the storage, retrieval, and manipulation of data in databases.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Which of the following is an application program that is stored on a remote server and delivered over the internet?
questions.answer: A Web application is an application program that is stored on a remote server and delivered over the internet. Users access it through a web browser without installing it locally.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: A group of computers connected together with the help of cables within an office building is called
questions.answer: A LAN (Local Area Network) is a group of computers connected together with cables within a limited area such as an office building, school, or home.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Digital information is converted into analog information by the modem at
questions.answer: Digital information is converted into analog information by the modem at the source computer. The modem modulates digital signals into analog for transmission over telephone lines. At the destination, it demodulates analog back to digital.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: A modem is connected in between a telephone line and a
questions.answer: A modem is connected in between a telephone line and a computer. It converts digital signals from the computer into analog signals for transmission over telephone lines, and vice versa.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What can you do with the internet?
options: Exchange information with friends and colleagues
Access pictures, sounds, video clips and other media elements
Find diverse perspective on issue from a global audience
questions.answer: With the internet, you can exchange information with friends and colleagues, access pictures, sounds, video clips and other media elements, and find diverse perspectives on issues from a global audience.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Which of these services will not be provided by a typical Internet Service Provider (ISP)?
questions.answer: A modem is typically not provided by an ISP. ISPs provide internet connectivity, email addresses, and technical help, but the modem is usually purchased separately by the user.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is survival stress?
questions.answer: Survival stress is a common response to danger in all people and animals. When you are afraid that someone or something may physically hurt you, your body automatically responds with a burst of energy so that you will be better able to survive the dangerous situation or escape it altogether. This is also known as the 'fight or flight' response.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Why is self regulation important in life?
questions.answer: Self-regulation is important in life because: (1) It allows you to keep a tab on your own emotions. (2) It enables you to develop the idea about what is appropriate behaviour and what is inappropriate behaviour in a given social condition. (3) It helps in controlling negative impulses and reciprocating emotions for actualizing set goals.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is an Operating System?
questions.answer: An Operating System is the system software that performs all basic tasks of a computer system. It works like an interface between the user and the computer hardware resources. It is a collection of programs that controls and coordinates the execution of all other tasks and functions in a computer system. It mainly provides an environment to run software and serves services to the computer hardware.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Explain any three characteristics or qualities of an entrepreneur.
questions.answer: Three characteristics of successful entrepreneurs: (1) Leadership: An entrepreneur must possess leadership qualities and must lead a team for achievement of goals. (2) Innovativeness: An entrepreneur should not restrict themselves to just one innovation but should use a combination of innovations to meet customer requirements. (3) Decision maker: An entrepreneur has to make many decisions to put business ideas into reality.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Explain the role and significance of entrepreneurs.
questions.answer: An entrepreneur is the organiser of society's productive resources. They assemble unused natural, physical and human resources, combine them properly, establish effective coordination, and make economic activities dynamic. Entrepreneurs contribute to capital formation for economic development and create maximum employment opportunities by establishing new industries, developing existing industries, and undertaking innovative activities.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Explain any four graphic filters.
questions.answer: Four graphic filters: (1) Smooth: It softens the contrast of an image, making it appear more even. (2) Sharpen: It increases the contrast of an image, making edges more distinct. (3) Remove noise: It removes single pixels from an image to clean up visual noise. (4) Invert: It inverts the colour values of a colour image or brightness values of a grayscale image, creating a negative effect.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Ridhima wants to know about mailing labels in word processor. Help her to find the answers: (a) What is mailing label? (b) What are the ways to prepare and print mailing labels?
questions.answer: (a) Mailing labels are pieces of paper with adhesive on the back that can be affixed to packages or envelopes to identify the name and address of a recipient. (b) Mailing labels can be created in two ways: (i) Printing multiple copies of a single label. (ii) Printing address lists where each label contains a different address.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: What is the use of consolidate option in Calc?
questions.answer: Data consolidation provides a way to combine data from two or more worksheets or ranges of cells into a worksheet or new range. It is the method of combining the data of several sheets into one sheet, making it easier to analyze and summarize data from multiple sources.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: How are fields, record and a table related to each other? Explain with the help of an example.
questions.answer: A table is a collection of related records. A record is a collection of related fields. A field is the smallest unit of data, representing a single piece of information. Example: In an Employee table, fields are Emp_No, E_Name, and Salary. The values (101, Anil, 45000) form one complete record. Multiple such records together form the Employee table.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Why do we use instant messaging?
questions.answer: Instant messaging is a set of communication technologies used for text-based communication between two or more participants over the internet. It is favored for its real-time communication, cost-effectiveness, and convenience. It enables quick exchanges, supports multimedia sharing, and facilitates group communication, making it an efficient and widely adopted form of modern communication.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: (a) Write the full form of the following terms: (i) WiMAX (ii) BPL. (b) Ramya wants to connect all the computers of her office wirelessly. Which wireless technology would be best suitable for her office?
questions.answer: (a) (i) WiMAX stands for Worldwide Interoperability for Microwave Access. (ii) BPL stands for Broadband over Power Line. (b) Wi-Fi technology would be best suitable for her office to avoid cabling. Wi-Fi allows high speed internet connections without the use of cables or wires.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Ojas had prepared a table of contents of the project work he had done in a word processor application. (a) Tell him the different steps to update the TOC. (b) Tell him the different steps to delete the TOC.
questions.answer: Writer does not update the table of contents automatically, so after any changes to headings, it must be updated manually. (a) To update TOC: (1) Right-click anywhere in the TOC. (2) From the pop-up menu, choose Update Table. The TOC will be updated automatically. (b) To delete TOC: (1) Right-click anywhere in the TOC. (2) From the pop-up menu, choose Delete Table option. The TOC will be deleted from the document.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Lavish is preparing notes for his upcoming exams. Help him to write the correct answer of the following: (i) Scenario (ii) Absolute link (iii) Relative link (iv) Macro
questions.answer: (i) Scenario: The Scenario manager is a what-if analysis tool. Each scenario is named and can be edited and formatted separately. When printing, only the contents of the currently active scenario are printed. (ii) Absolute link: An absolute link contains all the information necessary to locate a resource. It will stop working only if the target is moved. (iii) Relative link: A relative link locates a resource using an absolute URL as starting point. It will stop working if both the start and target locations change relative to each other. (iv) Macro: A macro is a saved sequence of commands/keystrokes/mouse presses that are stored for later use or to be used repeatedly.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: Define database management system. Write two advantages of using database management system for school.
questions.answer: Database Management System (DBMS) is a collection of programs that enable users to create, manipulate, maintain databases and control all access to the database. The primary goal of DBMS is to provide an environment that is both convenient and efficient for users to retrieve and store information. Advantages of using DBMS for school: (1) In school, DBMS is used to store data about students, teachers, and any other related information at a centralized location. (2) It provides security to the personal information of the school and stored data. (3) It reduces data redundancy and maintains consistency.

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: (a) State the relationship and difference between a primary and foreign key. (b) Write SQL command to create the table VEHICLES: Reg_No char(15) Primary Key, Reg_Date date, Owner_Name varchar(20), Address varchar(40). Also add some information.
questions.answer: (a) Relationship: A foreign key is the column or set of columns in one table that references the primary key column in another table. The primary key uniquely identifies each record in a table. Difference: A primary key cannot accept null values, while a foreign key can accept multiple null values. A table can have only one primary key but can have multiple foreign keys. (b) CREATE TABLE VEHICLES (Reg_No char(15) Primary Key, Reg_Date date, Owner_Name varchar(20), Address varchar(40)); INSERT INTO VEHICLES VALUES ('101', '2023-12-14', 'LearnCSE', 'Bangalore');

questions.subject: Information Technology
questions.question: (a) What are the benefits of online shopping? (b) How many types of web browser? Explain them.
questions.answer: (a) Benefits of online shopping: Online shopping offers convenience, allowing consumers to browse and purchase a vast array of products from the comfort of their homes. It provides access to a global marketplace, enabling shoppers to find unique items and compare prices effortlessly. Online platforms often feature customer reviews, aiding informed decision-making. The flexibility of 24/7 accessibility and doorstep delivery enhances the overall shopping experience. Frequent discounts and promotions make online shopping cost-effective. (b) Common web browsers include: (1) Google Chrome: Known for speed and simplicity, it is the most widely used browser. (2) Mozilla Firefox: Emphasizes privacy and customization with add-ons. (3) Apple Safari: Integrated with Apple devices for seamless browsing. (4) Microsoft Edge: Offers compatibility with Windows and integration with Microsoft services. (5) Opera: Features built-in tools like ad-blocker and free VPN.
